html:
Crowns & Bridges

Beautiful Dental Crowns in Kansas City, MO

If you have broken, missing, or discolored teeth and want to fix them, Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport has a solution for you. We are a leading provider of dental bridges and dental crowns in Kansas City, MO. We develop and customize implant solutions ourselves, ensuring patients always receive top quality. We'll create a one-of-a-kind solution that fits and matches your mouth precisely. It will be comfortable and convenient and enable you to speak, chew, and smile seamlessly. We can replace one or many missing teeth, allowing you a complete smile that is healthy, bright, and beautiful. We look forward to renewing your smile.
Contact Us

What's the Difference Between Crowns and Bridges?

Our team can determine whether you need a crown or a bridge after assessing your mouth and teeth. Other factors, such as tooth decay, disease, or loss, are essential to our decision-making process. Both implants have unique benefits that may be suitable for you. Here's how crowns and bridges differ from each other:

  • Crowns: Dental crowns are dental covers that hide cracked, chipped, or severely traumatized teeth. They are crafted to match the former tooth's look and condition.
  • Bridges: Dental bridges can replace one or multiple missing teeth. They alleviate the burdens placed on the jaw after tooth loss, restore structure, and strengthen teeth sets.

Seamless Crown and Bridge Implementation

We make it easy to return your smile to a functional, beautiful condition by following a simple process. First, we'll attend to the surrounding or targeted natural teeth to ready them for the implant. We'll prepare the surrounding natural teeth and apply local anesthesia if required or requested. Then, we'll install a temporary crown or bridge to meet your needs while your permanent implant is formulated. When the permanent implant is ready, we'll carefully remove the temporary one and replace it. You can rely on us to place your beautiful new implant safely and securely, ensuring quality for years to come.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
